title: Nutty Egyptian Chicken Toast
description: A jammy and creamy Egyptian dish featuring harissa spice, served on toast, perfect for meal prep
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together harissa spice, olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the harissa mixture.
Spread the chicken pieces on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, toast the pita bread slices.
In a small bowl, mix together the greek yogurt and lemon juice.
Once the chicken is done, let it cool for a few minutes before chopping it into smaller pieces.
Assemble the toast by spreading a layer of yogurt mixture on each pita slice, then topping with chicken, walnuts, and a sprinkle of harissa spice.
